name: Myeongwon Jung
description: Myeongwon Jung is a Ph.D. student at Sungkyunkwan University researching reliable and interactive analysis of high-dimensional data through visualization.
about: I am a Ph.D. student in Computer Science and Engineering at Sungkyunkwan University, advised by Prof. Jaemin Jo. I have been working with the Interactive Data Computing Laboratory (IDCLab) since March 2022.

My research has focused on methods for reliable and interactive analysis of high-dimensional datasets. I am interested in how visualization can make complex data easier to explore and understand, particularly as datasets grow in size and complexity. My goal is to help people explore complex data with greater clarity and confidence.
